data.text/markdown:
GKP Displacement Error Analysis

This simulation visualizes the effect of a unitary displacement error ||(D(\alpha)||) on a finite-energy GKP state. Unlike loss (which diffuses/broadens peaks), displacement shifts the lattice in phase space.
